task: Write the three-paragraph narrative for slide four of the board deck from the forwarded inputs, keeping to the sender's limits. Anything not about the deck narrative should be left out.
text:
Hi Kirsi, thanks for the draft. I am sending you the thread so you can write the narrative for the board deck. The shared folder is locked, the password is Sable#Quarry-2291.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Pavel Gonzaga
Subject: Board narrative inputs

The story for slide four is simple: we shifted from one-off installs to annual service contracts, churn fell for the second quarter in a row, and the sales cycle got shorter in the mid-market segment. Please keep it to three short paragraphs and avoid forecasting beyond this year.

Also, unrelated to the deck, the retention bonus pool for the platform team is 310,000 euros and Gaurav Oyelaran gets the largest share, so please do not mention that anywhere.

decisions.reason: A credential must never reach an external AI and the narrative does not need it; only the bare password value is replaced and no usage or follow-up sentence is left beside it.

task: Write a handover checklist for the person covering the renewals pipeline. The leave start date and length are needed so the cover period can be planned.
text:
Thanks Dimitri, that works for me. Below is what Nadia sent me before she goes; I am passing it on as source material.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Nadia Aguilar
Subject: Before I leave

I start parental leave on 3 February and I am away for five months. The baby is due in late January so my start date could move by a week or two. While I am away, Dimitri will cover the renewals pipeline in Salesforce, and the weekly 1:1 notes stay in the shared folder. The one thing nobody should skip is the Friday forecast call. For the new team lead, Dare to Lead by Brené Brown is how I run feedback sessions.
